provenance.usd_world_bounds_source: delivered USD visual geometry; stage world axes
provenance.verification_note: Authored metadata checked against delivered USD. High confidence applies to metadata consistency, not measured real-world properties or new native simulation qualification.

scale.note: Verified against delivered geometry and authored stage units; real-world dimensions are not calibrated.

mass.note: Positive authored rigid-body masses, units and JSON part sum checked; physical measurements are not independently calibrated.

collision.note: Authored collision APIs, enabled states, counts and finite mesh coordinates checked; collision cooking and contact stability are not revalidated.

articulation.note: Joint existence, enabled state, references and ordered limits checked; joint actuation is not revalidated by this metadata audit.

runtime.scope: NVIDIA Robotics-Prop native tests plus independent joint constraints and thumbnail checks
